abstract: Ovarian dermoids constitute the most common ovarian neoplasm and make up approximately 20% of all ovarian neoplasms. Dermoids are most common in the reproductive age group, but unlike other ovarian germ cell tumors, their age distribution is quite broad. Torsion may occur in approximately 15% of cases and is more common during pregnancy and in the 6 weeks immediately after delivery. We present a 17-year-old who came to the emergency department in her puerperium with severe right lower quadrant pain. The diagnosis of a 12-cm dermoid was missed at ultrasound. We discuss the reasons for the mistake on ultrasound and give strategies to prevent this from happening in the future. Three commonly overlooked teaching points regarding dermoids are discussed. Ultrasound and computed tomographic imaging, operative course, and correlative intraoperative and pathological images are presented.
abstract_ja: 卵巣皮様嚢腫は最も頻度の高い卵巣腫瘍であり、卵巣腫瘍全体の約20%を占める。皮様嚢腫は生殖年齢に最も多いが、他の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍とは異なり、年齢分布は非常に幅広い。捻転は症例の約15%に起こり、妊娠中および分娩直後の6週間に多い。我々は、産褥期に強い右下腹部痛を主訴に救急外来を受診した17歳の女性例を報告する。12cmの皮様嚢腫は超音波検査で診断を見逃された。超音波検査で誤りが生じた理由を考察し、今後これを防ぐための方策を示す。皮様嚢腫について見落とされやすい3つの教訓を述べる。超音波検査およびコンピュータ断層撮影の画像、手術経過、ならびに術中所見と病理組織学的所見の対応する画像を提示する。
